heading: Kaitiaki
opening: I tīmata a Kaitiaki i tētahi pātai kāore i taea e au te whakarere: ka ahatia taku ao matihiko mēnā ka pā tētahi aituā ki a au?
summary_1: He pouaka haumaru matihiko me ngā kī maha. Māu e whiriwhiri ko wai ngā kaipupuri, me te tokohia me huihui mai kia tuwhera ai: kia toru o te tokorima, kia rua o te tokorua, ko tāu e pai ai. Kāore e taea e te tangata kotahi te uru takitahi.
summary_2: Ka whiwhi ia tangata i tētahi paihere kei roto ngā mea katoa e hiahiatia ana. Ko te whakaora he huaki kōnae i te pūtirotiro, tuimotu*, kāore he pūkete, kāore he tūmau. Mēnā ka ngaro tēnei paetukutuku, ka mahi tonu te whakaora.
bg_title: He aha au i hanga ai i tēnei
bg_1: E rua ngā take i hanga ai au i a Kaitiaki.
bg_2: I taku mātakitaki i tētahi pakipūmeka mō Clive Wearing, he tangata kua noho me te wareware taumaha mai i te tau 1985, ka huri taku whakaaro mō taku ao matihiko ake. He pakarukaru ake te mahara i tā tātou e whakapono ai.
bg_3: He maha aku wharanga roro mai i ngā aituā eke paihikara. I ia wā, i waimarie au ki te ora katoa mai, engari ka piki haere ngā whakamaharatanga.
bg_4: I puta a Kaitiaki i tērā: he ara e taea ai e ngā tāngata e whakaponohia ana e au te uru ki ngā mea nui, kāore e utaina te taumahatanga katoa ki runga i te tangata kotahi.
bg_changelog: E tipu tonu ana a Kaitiaki. Tirohia te rārangi panonitanga kia kite ai i ngā mea hou.
how_subtitle: Māu e whiriwhiri ko wai ka whakaponohia, me te tokohia me whakaae. Ka whakamunatia ō kōnae, ka wehea te kī hei wāhanga, ā, ka puritia e ia tangata tētahi. Ka huihui mai te tokomaha e tika ana, ka tuwhera ngā kōnae.
how_caption: Mā tētahi tokotoru o te tokorima e taea ai te whakaora i ngā kōnae
how_fallback:
Tō Kōnae → Whakamuna → Wehea te kī kia 5 wāhanga → Tohaina ki ngā kaitiaki
↓
Tokotoru o ngā kaitiaki → Whakakotahi i ngā wāhanga → Huakina → Kua whakaorangia te kōnae
bundles_title: Ka whiwhi ia tangata i te aha
bundles_desc: Ka whiwhi ia tangata i tētahi paihere motuhake: he kōnae ZIP me tētahi taputapu whakaora e mahi ana i tētahi pūtirotiro noa, tuimotu, kāore he tāuta. Mēnā ka ngaro tēnei kaupapa, ka mahi tonu te whakaora.
bundles_contacts: Kei roto i ia paihere ngā taipitopito whakapā mō ērā atu tāngata, kia taea ai e rātou te whakarite tahi i te kore o koe.
trust_title: Mō te whakapono me te whakaū
trust_1: Ka mahi te whakaora ahakoa kua kore tēnei kaupapa. He motuhake ia paihere
trust_2: He puna tuwhera te waehere. Pānuitia i GitHub
trust_3: Mā tētahi arotake haumarutanga e whakamārama ngā whiringa whakamunatanga
trust_4: Ka rere ngā mea katoa ki tō pūrere ake. Kāore ō kōnae e wehe atu i tō pūrere
trust_5: Whakamātauria ngā paihere whakaaturanga i mua i te whakamahi mō tētahi mea nui
trust_6: Ka whakamahia e te whakamunatanga a age, he taputapu hou, e whakanuia ana
trust_7: Pānuitia anō mō ngā mea e tiaki ana i ō raraunga me ngā mea ka taea te hē
try_title: Kia kite me pēhea te mahi
try_step_3: Tōia ngā kōnae README a Bob rāua ko Camila ki runga i te whārangi
try_step_4: Ka rahi ngā wāhanga kua tāpirihia, ka tuwhera ngā kōnae
try_docker_summary: Kei te whakahaere paetuku ake koe? 🐳
try_docker_link: Tirohia te aratohu whakahaere paetuku ake mō ngā taipitopito.
try_note: Koinei te mea tino rite ki te āhua o tētahi whakaoranga tūturu.
whatis_title: He aha tēnei, he aha hoki ehara
whatis_is_1: Taputapu e rere ana i tō pūtirotiro, tuimotu*
whatis_is_2: Pouaka haumaru matihiko me ngā kī maha, e puritia ana e ngā tāngata e whakaponohia ana e koe
whatis_is_4: Motuhake. Ka mahi te whakaora i te kore o tēnei paetukutuku
whatis_isnt_3: Mea e penapena ana i ō raraunga ki hea rānei
footer_timelock: * Mō ngā pūranga kua rakaina ā-wā, me hono poto ki te ipurangi i te wā whakaora.
